Bill.BriefDescription: Excluding permit costs from excise taxation.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to exclusion of permit costs from excise taxation;adding a new section to chapter 82.04 RCW; adding a new section tochapter 82.08 RCW; and providing an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) In computing tax there may be deducted from the measure of taxamounts received by any person as compensation for permit fees paid bythe person as an accommodation to the customer. This deduction isavailable only if the amount is billed to the customer at the exactamount paid to the governmental entity and is separately itemized inthe billing statement delivered to the customer. (2) The definitions in this subsection apply to this section. (a) "Permit fee" means a fee charged by a governmental entity toapply for or obtain written authorization to engage in any particularactivity or act, including but not limited to fees charged for abuilding permit, development permit, conditional use permit, forestpractices permit, sewage disposal permit, or water resources permit. (b) "Impact fee" has the meaning provided in RCW 82.02.090.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The tax imposed by RCW 82.08.020 does not apply to amounts that aredeductible under section 1 of this act.
